entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Oh, hello? I... I think I need to return something. It's all very confusing, I'm not sure what to do.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you today. To get started, could you please tell me your name and order number?
It's Sarah Gable. The order number is... um... VF77891. It's about these cycling shoes I bought.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Apex Road Cycling Shoes, delivered on December 21st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I don't know? I tried them on my bike, and the part where the cleats attach feels all wrong. And after just one ride, I got terrible blisters on my heels. I looked at the website policy but I just don't get it. Can't you just help me?
I'm sorry to hear they caused blisters, Sarah. That definitely sounds uncomfortable. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've just pulled up our policy information. It looks like your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh, it is? The website said something about 10 days and 20 days... I was so overwhelmed.

No need to worry. We can absolutely process this return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email address on file right now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Really? Oh, thank you so much, Alex! That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for making it so simple.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
